C_aven_teral.name: Professor Aven Teral
C_aven_teral.role: Rex Fleet Academy professor of civic systems, logistics history, and institutional geography.
C_aven_teral.visualAnchor: Man in his early 50s with medium-brown skin, close-cropped silver-black hair, lean build, attentive dark eyes, and an understated academic presence.
C_aven_teral.wardrobe: Charcoal civilian lecturer coat over a white shirt with restrained Academy blue-and-gold trim; no combat armor and no admiral's decorations.
C_aven_teral.performance: Dry, patient, exacting. He teaches by making students commit to answers and then exposing what those answers fail to measure.
promptContinuity: Never stage Aven as a pompous lecturer or omniscient oracle; he listens closely and lets students discover complications.
His authority is academic and institutional, not theatrical.

C_lysa_renn.name: Cadet Lysa Renn
C_lysa_renn.visualAnchor: Young woman around 20 with warm brown skin, compact athletic build, dark curly hair cut to jaw length, alert expressive eyes, and precise posture.
C_lysa_renn.wardrobe: Clean Rex Fleet Academy cadet uniform in ion white with blue structure and narrow gold piping; practical boots, no ceremonial cape.
C_lysa_renn.performance: Quick, competitive, articulate, and sincerely proud of Meridian. She changes her mind only when evidence gives her a better model.
promptContinuity: Do not make Lysa smug or foolish; her opening assumptions are reasonable products of a Meridian education.
Her arc is from centrality to systems thinking, not from loyalty to cynicism.

C_corin_bale.name: Cadet Corin Bale
C_corin_bale.role: Engineering and ship-systems cadet from a Bastion Spire dock family.
C_corin_bale.visualAnchor: Young man around 21, broad-shouldered and stocky, fair skin with light freckles, sandy hair kept short, strong hands marked by old tool calluses.
C_corin_bale.wardrobe: Academy white-blue uniform worn with a compact utility overshirt allowed for engineering track work; gold rank piping remains minimal.
C_corin_bale.performance: Practical, mechanically minded, impatient with prestige, but deeply loyal to the Fleet infrastructure he grew up around.
promptContinuity: Corin notices maintenance access, machinery, schedules, and physical constraints before symbolism.
His skepticism of Meridian is local pride, not anti-Core resentment.

C_jalen_kesh.name: Cadet Jalen Kesh
C_jalen_kesh.role: Verge exchange cadet studying navigation and logistics.
C_jalen_kesh.visualAnchor: Young man around 20 with dark brown skin, tall narrow build, long black hair tied into one practical braid, observant eyes, and an easy stillness.
C_jalen_kesh.wardrobe: Standard Academy ion-white and blue cadet uniform with a single woven green Verge wrist cord retained as a personal keepsake; otherwise fully within Academy dress.
C_jalen_kesh.performance: Quiet until a hidden assumption matters, then very direct. He sees dependency and waiting because corridor reliability was never abstract where he grew up.
promptContinuity: Green is limited to Jalen's small personal Verge cord and verified corridor displays; do not recolor the Academy or Fleet green.
Do not make Jalen a moral mouthpiece; he can be wrong, incomplete, or too focused on frontier consequences.

C_ma_neris.name: Ma Neris
C_ma_neris.role: Meridian market baker and third-generation keeper of a family Shatterbread stall.
C_ma_neris.visualAnchor: Woman in her mid-60s with deep brown skin, sturdy build, silver hair wrapped in a practical head scarf, flour on her forearms, and quick amused eyes.
C_ma_neris.wardrobe: Layered market clothes beneath a dark apron, sleeves rolled for work; a small family lantern token at her belt.
C_ma_neris.performance: Busy, unsentimental, funny when she has time. She treats famine memory as lived household history rather than museum rhetoric.
promptContinuity: Keep Ma Neris working while she talks; bread, trays, flour, queues, and delayed deliveries remain physically present.
She is proud of Meridian without pretending Meridian feeds itself.

C_tomas_kade.name: Tomas Kade
C_tomas_kade.role: Senior civilian corridor-allocation controller at Core Spire Station.
C_tomas_kade.visualAnchor: Man in his early 40s with olive skin, close-shaved dark hair, average build, tired intelligent eyes, and the posture of someone used to making decisions while standing.
C_tomas_kade.wardrobe: Functional Core Spire logistics uniform in slate and white with small blue Fleet liaison tabs; headset and wrist slate, no ceremonial styling.
C_tomas_kade.performance: Fast, calm, and allergic to grand language while traffic is moving. He teaches the cadets by asking what their map is for.
promptContinuity: Tomas remains a civilian operations professional, not a military commander.
His workspace should feel busy and competent, with people solving real routing problems rather than posing around holograms.
